messages:
lina: POC with Nimbus Labs hit a 403 on all embed calls after they swapped keys. They rotated to a new key at ~09:12 UTC and then started failing. Can we triage?

martin: can you grab the raw response + request id? 403 usually means scope or project binding to a different org alias.

lina: paste from customer: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_YYZZ\" -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'` -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden `{"error":"forbidden","message":"insufficient_scope"}` no request id in body.

rob: infra shows request_id=2f9b7e logged for that call. auth service: `error auth: permission_denied token=sk_prod_YYZZ required_scopes=[embed:read] token_scopes=[embed:limited]`

martin: ah token was generated as `embed:limited` (internal shorthand) not `embed:read`. customer probably used the UI quick-create that defaulted to limited scopes.

lina: they said they used the same key across environments, maybe the provisioning template changed. quick fix: create a new service key with `embed:read` and share, or temporarily grant `embed:read` to existing key. Security ok with short TTL?

sec-bot: automated: key-creation detected key_id=sk_prod_YYZZ alt_scopes=[embed:limited] created_by=dee@redwood at 2026-03-21T09:11:45Z.

dee: security prefers we create a new service key with explicit scopes rather than editing an existing prod key. set TTL to 72h for POC, note in audit.

martin: agree. also cb that the customer uses project header `x-rw-project: nimbus-staging` which maps to org alias `nimbus-inc`. token is bound to org slug `nimbus`. two distinct issues possible: scope OR org alias. logs show insufficient_scope so start with scope.

lina: sent instructions to customer to test with a new key and example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_poc_A1B2\" \
  -H \"x-rw-project: nimbus-staging\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"probe\"}'
```

rob: once they confirm scope is fixed, we'll check for org alias by searching auth logs for `token=sk_poc_A1B2` and `err=invalid_org_binding` or `err=org_alias_mismatch`.

lina: they tried the new service key and got 200 with request_id=2f9b8a. great. they asked if we can add project aliases so they don't have to change the header across environments.

martin: we can add an alias mapping `nimbus-staging -> nimbus` for the POC. ops/security approval required for aliasing production names; choose TTL and add audit note.

dee: i'll approve a 7-day alias with audit comment `poc-nimbus temp alias`. ensure alias creation is logged.

sec-bot: automated: alias-change request queued id=alias-7789 by dee@redwood.

rob: alias applied. validated with test: request_id=2f9b9c shows token bound to org `nimbus` accepted for project `nimbus-staging`.

lina: customer also asked about pricing if traffic spikes during POC. i'll hand to AE separately. For now auth resolved, will follow up with rotation steps.
